data_audit.causal_prefix_audit: all admitted supervised endpoints; native template and token IDs
data_audit.loss: linear curve per labeled action, anchor previous observed label or zero initially; unknown context unlabelled
data_audit.mono: weight0.1 margin0.2 raw endpoint logodds on adjacent labeled unsafe actions in a dialog; one forward

curve: g(u)=(0.9+1.2u-1.5u^2)/1.14, u=(i+1)/N in current action span. Unsafe target=g; safe target=0. This is a soft artificial profile, not normalized token mass or token gold.
objective: L=mean_action[mean_action_tokens BCEWithLogits(z_i,y*g_i) +0.1*BCEWithLogits(event_logit,y)] inside each whole-dialog forward. Both losses simultaneous at EVERY step. No curve-only pretraining stage; never event-only training.
null: event_logit=logmeanexp(action token raw logits)-null_readout(last Mamba feature of that action); uniform location prior1/N; NULL initialized zero
linear_softmax: s=sum sigmoid(z)^2 / sum sigmoid(z). Event logit computed stably as logsumexp(2logsigmoid(z))-logsumexp(logsigmoid(z)+logsigmoid(-z)); no hard clipping.
architecture: Same original cached Qwen -> LN/projection2560to256 -> two residual prenorm Mamba2 -> LN -> token linear. NULL arm adds only Linear256to1. Fresh Mamba/readout, identical shared init, no LoRA/attention/mono.
loss_normalization: tokens within action; actions within dialog; accumulation4dialogs
precision: FP32 head with BF16 autocast; original native CUDA/Triton Mamba kernels
cache: Read-only complete original whole-dialog BF16 Qwen features. Cache IDs/revision/template/weights/environment validated. No Qwen load/reencoding.
selection: minimum hard EVENT validation BCE over4epochs
outputs: All four epoch heads, optimizer/RNG states, component losses, validation scores and token logits
gates: Both component readout gradients nonzero, token loss support/current action masks, NULL gradients only endpoints, both Mamba gradients, suffix causality, reload, longest backward; audit optimizer steps0 discarded
annotation: User-stopped, results preserved; new partial labels NOT added to immutable cached training data
teacher_servers: Our annotation client and GPT-OSS/Qwen serving stopped by user; other users tasks unchanged
limitations: One seed; prior chosen by manual discussion, not learned token gold. High early targets may be unpredictable on identical causal prefixes. Curve and event losses may trade off; components saved separately.
restart_reason: User requested 4 total epochs. Previous run did not save optimizer; fresh same-seed rerun, not optimizer-reset continuation.
